spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (ऊ) केलु (केलति)
1 To shake.
2 To go or move.

m. (-कः)
A dancer, a tumbler, one who walks or dances on the edge of a sword.
E.
किल to sport, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-सः)
Crystal.
E.
के in water, लस to shine, अंण aff.

mf. (-लिः लिः or -ली)
Play, sport, pastime, amusement.
f. (-लिः)
The earth.
E.
किल to sport, Uṇādi affix इ.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Sportive, sporting.
m. (-कः)
The Asoka tree.
E.
केलि and कन् added.

f. (-ला)
1 The Vīṇā or lute of SARASVATĪ.
2 Amorous or sportive accents or address.
3 Sportive skill, wantonness.
E.
केलि sport, कल to sound, affixes अङ् and टाप्.

m. (-लः)
One of ŚIVA'S attendant demigods.
2 The confidential companion of the hero of a drama, in general a sort of buffoon.
f. (-ला)
A name of RATI, the wife of KĀMADEVA.
E.
केलि sport, किल who plays, from किल to sport, affix क.

f. (-का)
A wife's younger sister.
E.
केलि play, कुचि to be crooked, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-षः)
An actor, a dancer or tumbler: see केलक.

n. (-हं)
A pleasure house, a private apartment.
E.
केलि sport, and गृह a house; also कलिनिकेतन, &c.

m. (-रः)
A sensualist, an enjoyer of worldly pleasures.
E.
केलि sport, and नागर a libertine, &c.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Wanton, sportive.
E.
केलि, and पर intent on.

m. (-खः)
Pastime, sport.
E.
केलि play, and मुख chief.

m. (-क्षः)
A species of the Kadamba, commonly Keli-Kadamba, (Nauclea cordifolia.)
E.
केलि sport, and वृक्ष a tree; being abundant in the scene of KṚṢṆA'S sports with the Gopīs.

n. (-नं)
A couch, a sofa.
E.
केलि, and शयन a bed.

m. (-वः)
Minister of the sports, master of the revels.
E.
केलि play, सचिव a counsellor, a minister.
